en: Black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard divided into four panels, each showing a different building in a small town or village. The upper left image shows a wide open square with a traditional half‑timbered house and other gabled houses. The upper right image shows a more formal institutional building with a central entrance portal and a small tower or belfry above the roof. The lower left view depicts a solid three‑storey building with arched ground‑floor windows and a steep tiled roof, likely a civic or school building. The lower right image shows another half‑timbered house attached to a simpler building, surrounded by trees and garden plots. No printed caption or visible writing appears on the front.
